last_summary: Required focus stages are complete. Among candidates, v1 provides the closest positive evidence for a character's mission being secretly monitored: a person walks toward an aircraft while a large screen displays that pilot's personnel profile and flight-path map, and later v1 includes aircraft/control-room/screen imagery. v2 more plausibly shows the man as the surveillant, v3 lacks established monitoring intent/target, and v4 has no direct positive monitoring claim. Remaining uncertainty is whether the walking man is explicitly the monitored subject, but A is the best-supported option.
